title: ECOD Technology Risk Consultant - SAMA Question Bank
header: * ECOD Technology Risk Consultant - SAMA Question Bank v{version} - the published,
* finalized catalogue for the Technology Risk Consultant - SAMA track.
* Organised MODULE -> FAMILY -> QUESTION. Generated by
* scripts/build-question-bank.py from the published source workbook
* ("SAMA Question bank 1.1.xlsx"); edit the generator (or the Admin UI),
*   R01, R02, A01, I01, O01, D01, B01, T01   Risk & Control   3 objective + 1 open served per module
*   F01, C01                                 Reporting & Client 1 open served per module
* Every generated test is (8 x 4) + (2 x 1) = 34 questions, shuffled so
* objective and open questions interleave rather than arriving in blocks.
* See src/core/test-generation.mjs for the selection logic.
* FAMILIES ARE SCOPED TO A MODULE. Each module in this bank is built around
* the question family the source workbook names for it, so the compound id
* `I01:iam-pam-segregation-of-duties`). A new question is added to exactly
* one such family, and `family_id` is what pins it there.
* `needs_option_review` marks an objective question that still needs an admin
* to complete its distractor text. The published v1.1 workbook carries all
* four options, so published objectives no longer set it.
groups: SAMA regulatory depth: CSF and ITGF, technology risk and control assessment, IAM/PAM, infrastructure and security operations, SDLC, resilience, third-party, cloud and data protection.
Findings, remediation and closure, banking context, reporting and client management.
